sections.h2: Aviation's projected net loss widens to ₹36,000-38,000 crore in FY2027

chart.title: Aviation loss estimates: FY2026 cut to ₹28,000-30,000 crore, FY2027 seen wider
chart.source: ICRA aviation notes, 2026; ICRA update of 27 August 2026.

sections.means: ICRA says airlines are unlikely to pass higher fuel, lease and operating costs fully through fares, so the pressure is expected to persist.
sections.todo: Track whether airlines recover costs through fares and whether the FY2027 domestic passenger growth guidance of 3-6% holds.

sections.h2: Banks: a deliberate credit slowdown, with the banking outlook kept Stable

chart.title: Credit growth is expected to ease from 15.9% to 11.0-11.7% in FY2027

sections.means: ICRA frames the slowdown as deliberate and keeps banking Stable, citing comfortable capitalisation and manageable asset quality.
sections.todo: Watch net interest margins, which ICRA expects to face pressure from elevated funding costs before an easing later in FY2027.

sections.h2: Renewables: 40-45 GW of the pipeline still lacks a signed power purchase agreement

chart.title: Over 150 GW is under construction, but 40-45 GW still lacks a signed PPA
chart.source: ICRA Indian Renewable Energy Sector note, June 2026; ICRA press release, 7 May 2026.

sections.means: Demand for renewable capacity is large, and ICRA names land, transmission, PPA-signing delays and discom health as the execution risks.
sections.todo: Check that a project's power purchase agreement is signed before financial close, since that contract drives its bankability.
